name: Color of White
source:
It has become winter, a season in which we long for sweet things. This time, what we present to all of you is, about a big sister who fell in love with her little sister
and a little sister whose big sister fell in love with her,
a somewhat pleasant, probably heart-warming,
sweet and fluffy, shortcake stew-like story.

[from [url=http://www.ghostyuri.com/2013/01/yuri-vn-color-of-white/]Wings of Yuri[/url]]
